items.quote: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
items.claim: A newborn bullock, sheep, or goat must stay with its mother for seven days. From the eighth day on it can be accepted as a burnt offering to the LORD.
items.action: prescribes a minimum age for animals offered in sacrifice
items.mechanism: seven days under the dam before the animal can be offered; acceptable from the eighth day
